# Support

If you need help with openkan, here is where to find it.

## Bug reports

Open a [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/PolderLabsVOF/openkan/issues/new/choose)
and select the **Bug report** template.

## Feature requests

Open a [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/PolderLabsVOF/openkan/issues/new/choose)
and select the **Feature request** template.

## Security vulnerabilities

Do **not** open an issue. See [`SECURITY.md`](./SECURITY.md) for how to
report a vulnerability privately.

## Questions

For quick questions that are not bugs or feature requests, use the
**Question / support** issue template. If the repository has GitHub
Discussions enabled, questions are welcome there too.
